glosses: pre-reform spelling (used until 1990) of joia; still used where the agreement hasn’t come into effect and may occur as a sporadic misspelling

examples.text: Tom foi pego tentando roubar jóias.
examples.en: Tom was caught trying to steal jewelry.

examples.text: Eles acreditavam que a jóia iria trazer um desastre.
examples.en: They believed the jewel would bring disaster.

examples.text: Mary usa jóias demais, na minha opinião.
examples.en: Mary wears too much jewelry, in my opinion.

examples.text: Tom comprou várias jóias para Maria.
examples.en: Tom has bought Mary a lot of jewelry.
